 TL;DR AI lead generation in 2026 is no longer about finding more leads. It’s about deciding who to contact, when to act, and why that moment matters. This guide breaks down how modern B2B sales teams evaluate AI lead generation tools by the role they play in the workflow, from data and intent to orchestration and outbound execution.
